title: End-to-End Enterprise Data Pipeline Flow
description: Interactive pipeline topology demonstrating real-time ingestion, distributed transformation, Medallion storage, and analytical serving.
note: Interactive conceptual architecture representing enterprise data engineering patterns.

stages.name: Source Systems
stages.description: Operational relational databases and distributed feeds publishing change streams and financial ledger events.

stages.name: Data Ingestion & CDC
stages.description: Capturing transactional updates continuously without source lock contention. Triggering serverless ingestion events.

stages.name: Data Processing & ETL
stages.description: Distributed cleansing, strict schema enforcement, currency conversions, business rules, and SCD Type 1 & 2 deduplication.
stages.highlight: ACID transactions with Delta MERGE INTO

stages.name: Medallion Lakehouse
stages.description: Scalable cloud object storage organized into Medallion tiers ensuring clear lineage, auditing, and high concurrency read performance.

stages.name: Analytics & Consumption
stages.description: Star schema marts and analytical views queried by financial analysts, executive dashboards, and ML modeling workflows.
